description: List the user's linked brokerage accounts with each account's ID, name, brokerage, total value, cash, buying power, and fractional share support. Use the returned IDs with other tools. Use refresh=true to request fresh balances when eligible. Currently supported: Charles Schwab, Coinbase, ETrade, Kraken, Moomoo, Public, Robinhood, Tastytrade, TradeStation, TradeStation Paper, Webull

refresh.description: When true, requests the freshest available brokerage data. Real-time refresh requires a Pro plan and has a 1 minute per-account cooldown. Omit or false to return the last synced data.

name: get_accounts
title: Get Accounts
